failureCleanup.source: ctx.runProgram=async()=>{assert(!ctx.programRequested,'ACTUAL_PROGRAM_ALREADY_STARTED');ctx.programRequested=true;try{await ctx.waitForOwnerGatewayReviews();ctx.programStarted=true;return await runProgram(ctx);}catch(error){controller.stop('ACTUAL_PROGRAM_FAILED');try{await ctx.cleanup();}catch(cleanup){throw new AggregateError([error,cleanup],'Program and cleanup failed');}throw error;}}
